in_hebrew.name: Egon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Egon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Egon is derived from the Old German word 'egan,' which means 'to struggle.' It was a popular name among the Germanic peoples and was borne by several early medieval rulers. The name is also associated with the Latin word 'egens,' meaning 'poor' or 'needy,' which may have added to its appeal as a name for a strong and resilient warrior.
